required: parameters have typed logical value identity
locals and loop variables have source binding identity
constants have typed value definitions
every instruction result has a typed logical value
logical value identity is independent from physical storage
every instruction has stable owner function/block/ordinal/opcode
every operand is an O edge to a defined logical value
every result is an R edge to exactly one logical value definition
result and operand cardinalities match the I record
callee kind is internal, foreign, or builtin/external
internal/foreign callee function ID is resolved when available
argument A edges preserve source order
call result values are the corresponding I/R results
every non-external block has one terminal T record
RETURN carries its return value when present
JUMP stores its sole target in target_negative and leaves zero/positive unset
BRANCH3 carries one condition value and negative/zero/positive block IDs
record order is deterministic
numeric IDs are deterministic semantic IDs rather than physical slots
stream is parseable and internally valid
Z 31 is emitted only after S1-S4 are complete
any unresolved semantic condition must emit a mask smaller than 31

identity_policy.source_binding_identity: function + lexical scope + source anchor + exact identifier
identity_policy.instruction_order: function order, block order, instruction order

two_pass_stage1_target.pass_1: lex/parse function signatures and source bindings; resolve function IDs and binding identities
two_pass_stage1_target.pass_2: stream semantic expression/control-flow lowering into S3IR2 v2 using reusable bounded scratch

stage1_integration_requirements: do not reinterpret the four legacy 365-entry value banks as the semantic namespace
do not reserve a permanent [0,64) semantic ID domain for parameters
do not require module-global arrays sized to total instruction/value cardinality
use bounded expression/operator/binding scratch and stream completed records
preserve exact argument order and BRANCH3 target ordering
fail closed on unresolved names, types, uses, calls, blocks, or terminators
codex_acceptance_gate: generate a Stage1 candidate without overwriting selfhost/compiler/s3c_stage1.s3
build that candidate with tools/build_stage1_compiler.py on Linux x86-64
run the candidate against focused semantic fixtures
only after representative and canonical-source conformance PASS may a canonical Stage1 patch be proposed
